prompts.melee:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art animation sheet. Input image1 is approved character design: use ONLY enemy01 the hooked melee scavenger at TOP LEFT. Image2 is the exact small native sprite scale/material reference; its first row is the same melee role. Create 12 genuine articulated animation poses of that SAME creature, all facing SCREEN RIGHT from fixed high-oblique top-down gameplay camera, as a four-column three-row sprite sheet with equal square cells. Keep slender hunched adult proportions, bone-white beaked skull mask with tiny red eye, asymmetrical scavenged dull steel shoulder armour, worn dark leather straps, ragged charcoal hood/cape, short restrained dark-red torn waist cloth, thin legs, pale hooked hand claws. No new costume or humanoid redesign; identical proportions across all poses. Native standing height around34pixels, width around28pixels; detailed small hard pixel clusters and flat 12-20 color shading, no smooth shading, no chibi or thick cartoon outlines. Slate #111820 #1d2731 #46515a #71808a, bone #e9ddc3 #d3cbb5 #aaafab, brown #5b4036 #896043, red #bd4653. Large clean equal margins between all silhouettes. Feet at identical relative baseline90percent cell height, body center at50percent width. Same pixel scale all twelve, prone poses not enlarged.
ROW1 four WALK cycle frames in place: left foot forward contact; passing knee with narrow stance; right foot forward contact; other passing knee. Hook arms and ragged cloth follow actual articulated steps, no translated duplicates.
ROW2 four ATTACK frames: c1 windup beginning curl right hook backward; c2 full windup pull shoulder and hook behind torso while leaning slightly back; c3 ACTIVE forward slash hook and whole forearm reaching screen-right with bent forward knee; c4 RECOVER lower hooks to original alert resting stance. Enough silhouette change to read each action, no floating slash effect.
ROW3 c1 HIT short torso recoil with feet grounded; c2 DEATH first buckle to knees; c3 DEATH falling to right, one hand supports; c4 DEATH lying still horizontally, hood/mask toward right, boots left, complete body all inside cell. No blood/gore.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, all gaps around/between limbs transparent, no painted checkerboard, no shadow/ground/grid/borders/labels/text. Exactly12 full-body poses, no additional creatures. Preserve original concept silhouette; this is a production action expansion, not a new style.
